newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber higher on European buying.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber higher on European buying.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were generally higher in early trading on Wednesday following some European buying.

They said March SIR20 was done at 53.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang and Medan, up 0.25 cents. In Belawan, rubber was done overnight at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb, up 0.25 cents, while in Jambi and Pontianak, prices rose 0.50 cents to 53.00.
"Prices went up because of some European demand. We also expect some orders to arrive today," he said, adding that no significant movements was seen in the market.
Dealers said market sentiment had weakened recently because of sustained thin U.S. demand.
